# Moonlit Scroll-Driven Portfolio — Master Instructions

For this project, follow these instructions on every task:

- Project stack: Vite, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Three.js with `@react-three/fiber`, GSAP, Lenis, Zustand, and Framer Motion.
- Keep visuals and existing behavior unless the user explicitly asks for a change.
- Do not use copyrighted game assets, logos, or characters.
- Never put per-frame values in React state; use refs, `useFrame`, or `store.subscribe`.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Keep all interactions keyboard accessible.
- After each task, run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`, and report both results.
- Do not start the next phase unless the user explicitly asks you to.
